entries.title: Install and update on Mac without Homebrew
entries.body: Open the disk image and drag Infinitary into Applications. Choose Stable or Alpha beside Version in Settings → General. When an update is available, choose Update and restart; Infinitary shows progress, checks the download, and keeps your saved work. Switching channels never installs an older version. Homebrew installations remain supported and keep using their usual Homebrew upgrade command.

picture.alt: The stable update notice offers View release and Update and restart.
